theorems.name: Submission.constancy_mdc_smooth_approx_identity_ae_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ψ : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (ψ k)) ∧ (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (ψ k)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ closedBall 0 (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1))) ∧ (∀ k y, 0 ≤ ψ k y) ∧ (∀ k, ∫ y, ψ k y ∂volume = 1) ∧ ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, LocallyIntegrable g volume → ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, Tendsto (fun k => convolution g (ψ k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))
